en: Black‑and‑white view of a quiet European street corner with a large, three‑storey neoclassical or late‑19th‑century building on the left, featuring a hipped roof, dormer window, and balcony. Behind it stands a taller structure with a more ornate roofline, and further down the street are additional multi‑storey buildings. Mature trees line the street on both sides, casting shadows on the pavement. A small group of people, including adults and children, stand near a lamppost in the foreground.
